item.skt: Ary+a many+dzu shrI nA ma saM gI ti s+ya a nu saM sA br-it+ti
item.coloph: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi phan yon gyi 'grel pa sngags kyi don snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal mkhas pa chen po dus kyi 'khor lo pa grags pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po A tsar+ya a b+ha ya badz+ra dang / dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
